correctness.rationale: For u>0 the eliminated-water identity a=A+mB holds with B=u+1/u-u'/u² and A=(u'/u²)'+(1+u²)u'/u². B constant would force nonconstant u to make the cubic 2u(u²-bu+1) constant on an interval, impossible. Thus two distinct B values reconstruct a,m on any positive nonconstant observation interval. Constant u=s gives a/m=s+s^{-1}; u=0 hides both parameters. An admissible infinitesimal parameter/state perturbation preserves u,u',u'' for every state and changes u''' by -epsilon*u²*B', proving the single-instant third-jet iff condition; analytic nonconstant B gives isolated singular instants. Symbolic Lie-derivative rederivation independently verified A+mB=a, its time derivative, second-jet invariance, third-jet difference, and the positive nonstationary singular example (6,1,2,1) with B'=0,B''=20. These are exact analytic identities, not numerical extrapolations.
